Title: Blink Ability
Description:
[h3]ROLLING AROUND AT THE SPEED OF SOUND[/h3]

Current version is v0.0.3
Most recent update [i]is[/i] [b]save breaking[/b], so your best bet is to downdate the mod to finish any current runs.

[h2]Introduction[/h2]

Blink is a short-range, physical teleport ability (unaffected by normality), that doubles as an attack if used to pass "through" a hostile creature. Blinking "through" a hostile creature places you on the other side of them and performs an attack. Depending on the source of blink, the attack is either a free action, or deals unavoidable damage.

[h3]Existing Content, Extended[/h3]
Renamed (previously "Blink Mutation") and broadly reworked, this mod now includes a plethora of new additions for the game.

The original mutation is still intact and works almost exactly the same (the damage scaling is a little more balanced), with most of the changes to its stability.

Prickle pigs are still around, but their faction(s) are visible now and they'll generate legendries and even lairs! Where they show up is now a little more precise, and hopefully sensical.

The Chaos Emeralds have had their stability greatly improved, in part, due to high demand. Testing has been extensive if not very robust (please report [i]any[/i] issues you still find with them).

[h3]New in This Version[/h3]
A new cybernetic for the genetically inclined, to gain access to blink [i]and[/i] and new cybernetic exclusive* ability, Flicker Strike.
* some creatures have this ability innately...

Flicker strike comes with 3 charges which can be extended with compute power (1:120). Using flicker strike to target a hostile creature within half your blink range will cause you to blink to them and back, attacking them as you do so and expending a charge, repeating until you run out of charges or the creature dies.

Cybernetic Blink/Cold Steel work a little differently, too. Instead of unavoidable damage, the action cost to attack is free as long as you have flicker charges, expending one each time you use it. Cyber blink's range can be extended with compute power (1:30) and can scale beyond the maximum available to the mutation.

This new cybernetic has some unique interactions with hologram bracelets, but that's all I'll say about it.

With a new cybernetic comes a new threat! The Putus Templar are making use of this new cyberntic in particularly lethal ways (genuinely, they're very dangerous). Brave an encounter with them and you might just walk away with a new (well, used) Overclocked Central Nervous System implant, if you walk away at all.

The new Templar will show up in most places that roughly equivalent otehr Templar would show up, as well as more frequently in a few additional locations (mostly deep underground).

Prickle pigs now result in prickle pig golems. If that doesn't make sense to you, then you should stop reading and progress the main story.

[spoiler]Previously, when constructing the golem, a prickle pig companion would result in an oddity golem, but no longer! Complete with its very own tile, prickle pig golems are now an available option.[/spoiler]
